rules.text: Person, role, standing assignment, roster shift and IAM grant have distinct identities.
Every shift references an eligible standing assignment and a pinned roster revision.
Roster membership, substitution and handover never create or imply access rights.
Roster revision intervals do not overlap for one roster and as-of resolution is deterministic.
Every revision pins timezone, tzdb release, DST policy and a verifiable digest algorithm and canonicalization.
Shift overrides are attributable overlays and never rewrite the immutable roster revision digest.
Handover records outgoing and incoming shifts, instant, open work and incoming acknowledgment or an explicit gap.
Incoming duty may not act on an in-flight change before handover acknowledgment.
Escalation resolves a role or service through the roster as of event time and never pins a shift occurrence.
Dependency direction is rule to roster; the roster never owns or references the escalation rule.
The roster root remains stable across revisions; supersession is revision-level only.
Retirement requires retiredAt and an explicit inventory of uncovered open work.
Every instant is RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offset; assertedAt orders correction successors.
Roster retirement never closes employment, assignments, incidents or executions.
